🎥🎬: Lanterns (2026)

Hal Jordan, a veteran Green Lantern, is assigned to train a young and determined John Stewart. Their uneasy partnership takes a dark turn when they are sent to Rushville, Nebraska, to investigate a mysterious murder that appears to be connected to something far more dangerous.

As Hal and John dig deeper, they uncover secrets hidden beneath the quiet town, including an extraterrestrial threat and enemies hiding in plain sight. But the investigation also forces John to confront the complicated relationship between himself and his mentor, as Hal’s decisions repeatedly put his life at risk.

When Hal’s story reaches its devastating conclusion, John returns to Rushville determined to uncover the truth. What begins as a murder investigation ultimately becomes John’s journey toward becoming a Green Lantern in his own right—and accepting the responsibility that comes with the ring.

source_details.synopsis: Lanterns is an American superhero television series created by Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King for HBO, based on the DC Comics Green Lantern characters Hal Jordan and John Stewart. It is the third television series in the DC Universe (DCU). It features experienced Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart as they team up with local sheriff Kerry Kane to investigate murders in Rushville, Nebraska that leads to a wider mystery. The series was produced by DC Studios and Warner Bros. Television with Mundy serving as showrunner. Kyle Chandler, Aaron Pierre and Kelly Macdonald respectively star as Jordan, Stewart and Kerry.
